content_statement: Chunks are verbatim excerpts of the recorded official source material, re-grouped by topic/paragraph with font-artifact character repair only. The builder is team-authored (Role 04); chunk content is not team-authored and not NASA-authored-by-this-team. Availability/readiness facts are never stored in chunks; they live only in the readiness registry module.
encoding_notes: data/nasa/expanded_v2/docs/rag_additions.jsonl contains mixed UTF-8 and cp1252 bytes (raw 0xB0 degree signs inside UTF-8 text); decoded with a hybrid UTF-8/cp1252 decoder. PDF-extracted private-use-area glyphs were mapped through a documented table or dropped when unknown.
